map.纯格式化不会——它只调整空白与缩进，不改变选择器或声明本身。但要留意：某些压缩器: Pure formatting does not — it only adjusts whitespace and indentation, leaving selectors and declarations untouched. Bear in mind that some minifiers rewrite 0px as 0, strip the semicolon after the last declaration, or merge properties with the same value; those are semantics-preserving rewrites from the minification step, and formatting will not undo them.

map.先对 CSS 做词法切分得到记号序列，随后按记号重排输出：空白记号跳过；注释记号: First tokenize the CSS, then emit tokens: whitespace is skipped; comment tokens go on their own line (starting a new line if not already at line start) and return to line start; a left brace outputs as “space + { + newline” and increments depth; a right brace decrements depth (not below 0), starts a new line, and indents the brace, adding a blank line if any non-whitespace token follows; a semicolon outputs as “; + newline”; a colon outputs as “: + space”; words at line start are indented, those right after a colon are appended, and otherwise a space is prepended. Finally trim and append a newline.
